summary_1line: Rama receives Sita’s jewel from Hanuman and, overwhelmed with grief and longing, recalls her and urges immediate action to reach her.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama presses Sita’s jewel to his chest, tears in his eyes, while Lakshmana stands beside him and Hanuman watches respectfully.
The radiant pearl jewel gleams in Rama’s hands as he remembers Sita wearing it upon her brow.
Rama, eyes wet with grief, implores Hanuman to recount Sita’s words again as the vanaras gather around.
